planning_notes: The request for 5 targets is fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct core concepts from the available 9. To ensure non-redundancy and high quality at a MEDIUM difficulty level, each target is assigned a unique pedagogical facet. This ensures that while the concepts are related (all part of a neural network training pipeline), the assessment angles (mechanism, rationale, code, prediction, diagnosis) are distinct, covering a broad range of cognitive skills from understanding to analysis.
